#!/usr/bin/env bash
# lane-class: runnable
# lanes/spark-openclaw-autoreview/run.sh - Spark-2 host-native OpenClaw/autoreviewer lane.
set -uo pipefail

TARGET="${SPARK_OPENCLAW_AUTOREVIEW_TARGET:-spark-2}"
REMOTE_WORKTREE=""
MODE="local"
BASE=""
ENGINE="codex"
REVIEWERS=""
MODEL=""
THINKING=""
PR_URL=""
OPERATOR_ID="${SPARK_OPENCLAW_OPERATOR_ID:-}"
DRY=0
QUEUE=0
QUEUE_STATUS=0
WATCH_ONCE=0
WATCHER_STATUS=0
QUEUE_STATE=""
REQUEST_ID=""
QUEUE_REQUEST_ID=""
ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT=0

require_value() {
  local opt="${1:-}"
  if [ "$#" -lt 2 ] || [ -z "${2:-}" ]; then
    echo "run.sh: $opt requires a value" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
}

while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --target) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; TARGET="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --remote-worktree|--repo) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; REMOTE_WORKTREE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --mode) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; MODE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --base) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; BASE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --engine) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; ENGINE="$2"; REVIEWERS=""; shift 2 ;;
    --reviewers|--panel) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; REVIEWERS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --model) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; MODEL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --thinking) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; THINKING="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --pr-url) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; PR_URL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --operator-id) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; OPERATOR_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --queue-state) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; QUEUE_STATE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --request-id) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; REQUEST_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --queue-request-id) require_value "$1" "${2:-}"; QUEUE_REQUEST_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --activation-preflight) ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT=1; shift ;;
    --watch-once) WATCH_ONCE=1; shift ;;
    --watcher-status) WATCHER_STATUS=1; shift ;;
    --queue-status) QUEUE_STATUS=1; shift ;;
    --queue) QUEUE=1; shift ;;
    --dry) DRY=1; shift ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '3,45p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "run.sh: unknown arg: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

if [ "$ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT" = "1" ]; then
  REMOTE_WORKTREE="${REMOTE_WORKTREE:-__activation_preflight__}"
fi

[ -z "$REQUEST_ID" ] || case "$REQUEST_ID" in
  -*|.*|*/*|*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*)
    echo "run.sh: unsafe --request-id: $REQUEST_ID" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
[ -z "$QUEUE_REQUEST_ID" ] || case "$QUEUE_REQUEST_ID" in
  -*|.*|*/*|*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*)
    echo "run.sh: unsafe --queue-request-id: $QUEUE_REQUEST_ID" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
[ -z "$OPERATOR_ID" ] || case "$OPERATOR_ID" in
  -*|.*|*/*|*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*)
    echo "run.sh: unsafe --operator-id: $OPERATOR_ID" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

if [ -z "$REQUEST_ID" ] && [ "$QUEUE_STATUS" != "1" ] && [ "$WATCH_ONCE" != "1" ] && [ "$WATCHER_STATUS" != "1" ]; then
  [ -n "$REMOTE_WORKTREE" ] || { echo "run.sh: --remote-worktree <spark-2-path> required" >&2; exit 2; }
fi
[ "$QUEUE" = "1" ] && [ "$WATCH_ONCE" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue and --watch-once are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$QUEUE" = "1" ] && [ "$WATCHER_STATUS" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue and --watcher-status are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$QUEUE" = "1" ] && [ "$QUEUE_STATUS" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue and --queue-status are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$QUEUE_STATUS" = "1" ] && [ "$WATCH_ONCE" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue-status and --watch-once are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$QUEUE_STATUS" = "1" ] && [ "$WATCHER_STATUS" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue-status and --watcher-status are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$QUEUE_STATUS" = "1" ] && [ -n "$REQUEST_ID" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue-status and --request-id are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$WATCH_ONCE" = "1" ] && [ "$WATCHER_STATUS" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --watch-once and --watcher-status are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -n "$REQUEST_ID" ] && [ "$QUEUE" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --request-id and --queue are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "$QUEUE_REQUEST_ID" ] || [ "$QUEUE" = "1" ] || { echo "run.sh: --queue-request-id requires --queue" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -n "$REQUEST_ID" ] && [ "$WATCH_ONCE" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --request-id and --watch-once are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -n "$REQUEST_ID" ] && [ "$WATCHER_STATUS" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --request-id and --watcher-status are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$QUEUE" = "1" ] && [ -z "$OPERATOR_ID" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue requires --operator-id <safe-id> for multi-operator review proof" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$WATCH_ONCE" = "1" ] && [ -z "$QUEUE_STATE" ] && { echo "run.sh: --watch-once requires --queue-state <spark-state-root>" >&2; exit 2; }
if [ "$ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT" = "1" ]; then
  [ "$QUEUE" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue and --activation-preflight are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
  [ "$QUEUE_STATUS" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --queue-status and --activation-preflight are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
  [ "$WATCH_ONCE" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --watch-once and --activation-preflight are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
  [ "${WATCHER_STATUS:-0}" = "1" ] && { echo "run.sh: --watcher-status and --activation-preflight are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
  [ -n "$REQUEST_ID" ] && { echo "run.sh: --request-id and --activation-preflight are separate modes" >&2; exit 2; }
fi

case "$MODE" in
  local|branch|commit) ;;
  *) echo "run.sh: --mode must be local, branch, or commit" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

if [ -z "$REQUEST_ID" ] && [ -n "$PR_URL" ] && [ "$MODE" = "local" ]; then
  echo "run.sh: --pr-url review proof requires --mode branch --base <ref> or --mode commit; omit --pr-url for local queue smoke" >&2
  exit 2
fi

if [ -z "$REQUEST_ID" ] && [ -n "$PR_URL" ] && [ "$MODE" = "branch" ] && [ -z "$BASE" ]; then
  echo "run.sh: --pr-url --mode branch requires --base <ref>" >&2
  exit 2
fi

case "$TARGET" in
  spark-2|spark-2.swarm) ;;
  -*) echo "run.sh: --target must be spark-2 or spark-2.swarm" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  *) echo "run.sh: --target must be spark-2 or spark-2.swarm" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { echo "run.sh: not in a git repo" >&2; exit 2; }
cd "$REPO_ROOT" || exit 2

. "$REPO_ROOT/lanes/lib/lane-receipt.sh"
lane_receipt_init spark-openclaw-autoreview
LANE_HOST="spark-2"

mark_swarmdash_publish_needed() {
  local event_name="$1"
  local detail="${2:-}"
  local recorder="$REPO_ROOT/tonight-lab/scripts/record-swarm-event.sh"
  local suffix
  local out_file
  local err_file

  suffix="$(printf '%s' "$event_name" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_')"
  out_file="$local_dir/swarmdash-publish-needed-$suffix.txt"
  err_file="$local_dir/swarmdash-publish-needed-$suffix.err"

  if [ ! -f "$recorder" ]; then
    printf 'missing:%s' "$recorder"
    return 0
  fi

  if bash "$recorder" \
    --source spark-openclaw-autoreview \
    --event "$event_name" \
    --lane spark-openclaw-autoreview \
    --detail "$detail" >"$out_file" 2>"$err_file"; then
    printf '%s' "$out_file"
    return 0
  fi

  echo "spark-openclaw-autoreview: failed to mark SwarmDash publish-needed for $event_name; see $err_file" >&2
  printf 'failed:%s' "$err_file"
  return 0
}

run_id="$LANE_RUN_ID"
local_dir="$REPO_ROOT/runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id"
mkdir -p "$local_dir"

if [ "$WATCHER_STATUS" = "1" ]; then
  watcher_status_script='
set -u
queue_state="$1"
run_id="$2"
dry="$3"
root="${queue_state:-$HOME/.local/state/openclaw-review}"
watcher="$HOME/Developer/spark-dgx/lanes/openclaw-review/autoreview-watch.sh"

[ -x "$watcher" ] || { echo "spark-openclaw-watcher-status: watcher missing: $watcher" >&2; exit 20; }
[ -d "$root" ] || { echo "spark-openclaw-watcher-status: queue root not found: $root" >&2; exit 21; }
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "spark-openclaw-watcher-status: missing python3" >&2; exit 22; }
command -v ps >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "spark-openclaw-watcher-status: missing ps" >&2; exit 23; }

if [ "$dry" = "1" ]; then
  printf "queue_root=%s\n" "$root"
  printf "watcher=%s\n" "$watcher"
  exit 0
fi

out_dir="$HOME/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-watcher-status-runs/$run_id"
mkdir -p "$out_dir"
ROOT="$root" OUT_DIR="$out_dir" RUN_ID="$run_id" WATCHER="$watcher" python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json
import os
import shlex
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["ROOT"])
out_dir = Path(os.environ["OUT_DIR"])
run_id = os.environ["RUN_ID"]
watcher = Path(os.environ["WATCHER"])
default_root = Path.home() / ".local" / "state" / "openclaw-review"
def normalize_root(value):
    try:
        return Path(value).expanduser().resolve(strict=False)
    except OSError:
        return Path(value).expanduser()
root_norm = normalize_root(str(root))
default_root_norm = normalize_root(str(default_root))
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

states = [
    ("requests", "queued"),
    ("running", "running"),
    ("needs-human", "needs-human"),
    ("done", "completed"),
    ("failed", "failed"),
]
queue_counts = {}
queue_total = 0
for dirname, status in states:
    folder = root / dirname
    count = len(list(folder.glob("*.json"))) if folder.exists() else 0
    queue_counts[status] = count
    queue_total += count

ps_result = subprocess.run(
    ["ps", "-eo", "pid=,ppid=,etime=,state=,args="],
    text=True,
    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
    stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    check=False,
)
processes = []
if ps_result.returncode == 0:
    for line in ps_result.stdout.splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split(None, 4)
        if len(parts) < 5:
            continue
        pid, ppid, etime, state, args = parts
        try:
            arg_tokens = shlex.split(args)
        except ValueError:
            arg_tokens = args.split()
        if not arg_tokens:
            continue
        def token_basename(token):
            return Path(token).name
        first_arg = token_basename(arg_tokens[0])
        launcher_names = {"bash", "sh", "zsh", "env", "nohup", "setsid", "timeout"}
        executing_watcher = first_arg == "autoreview-watch.sh" or (
            first_arg in launcher_names
            and any(token_basename(token) == "autoreview-watch.sh" for token in arg_tokens[1:])
        )
        if not executing_watcher:
            continue
        if any("spark-openclaw-watcher-status" in token for token in arg_tokens):
            continue
        env_readable = False
        env_root = None
        try:
            raw_env = Path("/proc") / pid / "environ"
            env_parts = raw_env.read_bytes().split(b"\0")
            env_readable = True
        except OSError:
            env_parts = []
        for env_part in env_parts:
            if env_part.startswith(b"OPENCLAW_REVIEW_STATE="):
                env_root = env_part.split(b"=", 1)[1].decode("utf-8", "replace")
                if env_root == "":
                    env_root = None
                break
        env_root_matches = normalize_root(env_root) == root_norm if env_root is not None else False
        arg_root_values = []
        for index, token in enumerate(arg_tokens):
            if token.startswith("OPENCLAW_REVIEW_STATE="):
                arg_root_values.append(token.split("=", 1)[1])
            elif token.startswith("--queue-state=") or token.startswith("--state="):
                arg_root_values.append(token.split("=", 1)[1])
            elif token in {"--queue-state", "--state"} and index + 1 < len(arg_tokens):
                arg_root_values.append(arg_tokens[index + 1])
        explicit_root_match = any(
            normalize_root(value) == root_norm
            for value in arg_root_values
        )
        argv_queue_state_seen = bool(arg_root_values)
        default_root_match = (
            root_norm == default_root_norm
            and env_readable
            and env_root is None
            and not argv_queue_state_seen
        )
        queue_root_matches = env_root_matches or explicit_root_match or default_root_match
        if env_root_matches:
            queue_root_source = "env"
        elif explicit_root_match:
            queue_root_source = "args"
        elif default_root_match:
            queue_root_source = "default"
        else:
            queue_root_source = "none"
        mode = "once" if "--once" in args.split() else "long-lived"
        process_runnable = not state.upper().startswith(("T", "Z"))
        active_candidate = queue_root_matches and mode == "long-lived" and process_runnable
        processes.append({
            "pid": pid,
            "ppid": ppid,
            "etime": etime,
            "state": state,
            "command": "autoreview-watch.sh",
            "mode": mode,
            "queue_root_matches": queue_root_matches,
            "queue_root_source": queue_root_source,
            "env_readable": env_readable,
            "env_queue_state_seen": env_root is not None,
            "argv_queue_state_seen": argv_queue_state_seen,
            "process_runnable": process_runnable,
            "active_candidate": active_candidate,
        })

watcher_active = any(process["active_candidate"] for process in processes)
summary = {
    "schema": "spark_openclaw_watcher_status.v1",
    "lane": "spark-openclaw-autoreview",
    "host": "spark-2",
    "run_id": run_id,
    "queue_root": str(root),
    "watcher": str(watcher),
    "watcher_exists": watcher.exists(),
    "watcher_executable": os.access(watcher, os.X_OK),
    "watcher_active": watcher_active,
    "process_count": len(processes),
    "processes": processes,
    "queue_counts": queue_counts,
    "queue_total": queue_total,
    "ps_exit_code": ps_result.returncode,
}
(out_dir / "WATCHER_STATUS.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
(out_dir / "STATE.md").write_text(
    "\n".join([
        "# Spark OpenClaw Watcher Status State",
        "",
        "status: completed",
        f"run_id: {run_id}",
        f"queue_root: {root}",
        f"watcher_active: {str(watcher_active).lower()}",
        f"process_count: {len(processes)}",
        f"queue_total: {queue_total}",
        "",
    ])
)

proof_lines = [
    "# Spark OpenClaw Watcher Status Proof",
    "",
    "- lane: spark-openclaw-autoreview",
    "- host: spark-2",
    f"- run_id: {run_id}",
    f"- queue_root: {root}",
    f"- watcher: {watcher}",
    "- result: completed",
    "- watcher_status_json: WATCHER_STATUS.json",
    "- state: STATE.md",
    f"- watcher_active: {str(watcher_active).lower()}",
    f"- process_count: {len(processes)}",
    f"- queue_total: {queue_total}",
]
for status, count in queue_counts.items():
    proof_lines.append(f"- queue_{status}: {count}")
proof_lines.extend([
    "- secrets_inspected: no",
    "- edits: no",
    "- deploys: no",
    "- sends: no",
    "- watcher_restarted: no",
    "- model_launched: no",
    "",
    "This is a read-only Spark-2 watcher and queue-root status proof.",
    "It does not submit a review, drain the queue, restart services, launch a model, or read raw model output.",
    "Process details are sanitized to pid/ppid/elapsed/state/mode/match booleans only; raw command lines and environment values are not copied.",
    "",
])
(out_dir / "PROOF.md").write_text("\n".join(proof_lines))
PY
'
  watcher_status_errexit=0
  case "$-" in *e*) watcher_status_errexit=1; set +e ;; esac
  status_out="$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -- "$TARGET" "bash -s -- $(printf '%q' "$QUEUE_STATE") $(printf '%q' "$run_id") $(printf '%q' "$DRY")" <<<"$watcher_status_script" 2>&1)"
  status_rc=$?
  [ "$watcher_status_errexit" = "0" ] || set -e
  printf '%s\n' "$status_out" >&2

  if [ "$DRY" = "1" ]; then
    if [ "$status_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="launch_only"
      lane_emit dry "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview watcher status validated on $TARGET" ""
      exit 0
    fi
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview watcher status dry probe failed rc=$status_rc" "see stderr"
    exit 3
  fi

  rsync -az -- "$TARGET:~/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-watcher-status-runs/$run_id/" "$local_dir/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  proof_rel="runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id/PROOF.md"
  status_file="$local_dir/WATCHER_STATUS.json"
  if [ "$status_rc" -ne 0 ] || [ ! -f "$status_file" ] || [ ! -f "$local_dir/PROOF.md" ]; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview watcher status failed rc=$status_rc" "missing watcher status proof"
    exit 3
  fi
  watcher_active="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(str(bool(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("watcher_active"))).lower())' "$status_file" 2>/dev/null || printf 'false')"
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
  LANE_TERMINAL_PROOF="$proof_rel"
  lane_emit completed "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview watcher status fetched on $TARGET; active=$watcher_active" ""
  exit 0
fi

if [ -n "$REQUEST_ID" ]; then
  request_status_script='
set -u
request_id="$1"
queue_state="$2"
run_id="$3"
dry="$4"
expected_operator_id="${5:-}"
root="${queue_state:-$HOME/.local/state/openclaw-review}"

if [ "$dry" = "1" ]; then
  [ -d "$root" ] || { echo "spark-openclaw-request-status: queue root not found: $root" >&2; exit 21; }
  command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "spark-openclaw-request-status: missing python3" >&2; exit 22; }
  printf "queue_root=%s\n" "$root"
  exit 0
fi

out_dir="$HOME/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-request-status-runs/$run_id"
mkdir -p "$out_dir"
ROOT="$root" REQUEST_ID="$request_id" RUN_ID="$run_id" OUT_DIR="$out_dir" EXPECTED_OPERATOR_ID="$expected_operator_id" python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["ROOT"])
request_id = os.environ["REQUEST_ID"]
run_id = os.environ["RUN_ID"]
out_dir = Path(os.environ["OUT_DIR"])
expected_operator_id = os.environ.get("EXPECTED_OPERATOR_ID") or ""
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def read_review_output(path):
    if not path.exists():
        return ""
    try:
        return path.read_text(errors="replace")
    except OSError:
        return ""

def summarize_review(result, review_output):
    raw_result = result.get("review_result") or ""
    exit_code = result.get("exit_code")
    exit_code_text = str(exit_code) if exit_code is not None else ""

    def raw_finding_count():
        lowered = raw_result.lower()
        for pattern in (
            r"\b(\d+)\s+(?:accepted\s+)?(?:actionable\s+)?findings?\b",
            r"\bfindings?\s*[:=]\s*(\d+)\b",
        ):
            match = re.search(pattern, lowered)
            if match:
                return int(match.group(1))
        return None

    def output_finding_count():
        clean_pattern = r"no (?:accepted/actionable |actionable |accepted )?findings reported\.?"
        for line in review_output.splitlines():
            normalized = re.sub(r"^[-*]\s+", "", line.strip().lower())
            if not normalized:
                continue
            match = re.match(r"autoreview findings:\s*(\d+)\b", normalized)
            if match:
                return int(match.group(1))
            if re.fullmatch(clean_pattern, normalized):
                return 0
        return None

    finding_count = output_finding_count()
    source = "review_output" if finding_count is not None else "unknown"
    if finding_count is None:
        finding_count = raw_finding_count()
        source = "review_result" if finding_count is not None else "unknown"

    if exit_code_text and exit_code_text not in {"0", "1"}:
        return {
            "review_clean": None,
            "review_finding_count": None,
            "review_summary": f"unknown; run failed (exit {exit_code_text})",
            "review_summary_source": "exit_code",
        }

    if exit_code_text in {"0", "1"}:
        exit_clean = exit_code_text == "0"
        if finding_count is not None and (finding_count == 0) != exit_clean:
            return {
                "review_clean": None,
                "review_finding_count": finding_count,
                "review_summary": f"conflict; exit_code={exit_code_text}, text={finding_count} findings",
                "review_summary_source": f"{source}+exit_code",
            }
        if exit_clean:
            count = finding_count if finding_count is not None else 0
            return {
                "review_clean": True,
                "review_finding_count": count,
                "review_summary": f"clean; {count} findings",
                "review_summary_source": source if finding_count is not None else "exit_code",
            }
        count_text = finding_count if finding_count is not None else "unknown"
        return {
            "review_clean": False,
            "review_finding_count": finding_count,
            "review_summary": f"actionable; {count_text} findings",
            "review_summary_source": source if finding_count is not None else "exit_code",
        }

    if finding_count is not None:
        clean = finding_count == 0
        if clean:
            review_summary = f"clean; {finding_count} findings"
        else:
            review_summary = f"actionable; {finding_count} findings"
    else:
        clean = None
        review_summary = "unknown"
    return {
        "review_clean": clean,
        "review_finding_count": finding_count,
        "review_summary": review_summary,
        "review_summary_source": source,
    }

states = {
    "requests": "queued",
    "running": "running",
    "done": "completed",
    "needs-human": "needs-human",
    "failed": "failed",
}

found_state = None
request_path = None
for dirname, status in states.items():
    candidate = root / dirname / f"{request_id}.json"
    if candidate.exists():
        found_state = status
        request_path = candidate
        break

summary = {
    "id": request_id,
    "found": bool(request_path),
    "status": "not-found",
    "queue_state": "",
    "queue_root": str(root),
    "request_path": "",
    "result_path": "",
    "review_output_path": "",
    "proof_path": "",
    "commit_sha": "",
    "submitted_head": "",
    "pr_url": "",
    "review_result": "",
    "review_clean": None,
    "review_finding_count": None,
    "review_summary": "",
    "review_summary_source": "",
    "operator_id": "",
    "expected_operator_id": expected_operator_id,
    "exit_code": None,
    "wall_s": None,
}

if request_path is None:
    (out_dir / "REQUEST_STATUS.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    (out_dir / "PROOF.md").write_text(
        "\n".join([
            "# Spark OpenClaw Request Status Proof",
            "",
            "- lane: spark-openclaw-autoreview",
            "- host: spark-2",
            f"- run_id: {run_id}",
            f"- request_id: {request_id}",
            "- operator_id: {}".format(summary["operator_id"] or "missing"),
            "- expected_operator_id: {}".format(expected_operator_id or "not_provided"),
            f"- queue_root: {root}",
            "- result: not-found",
            "- request_json: missing",
            "- result_json: missing",
            "- review_output: missing",
            "- secrets_inspected: no",
            "- edits: no",
            "- deploys: no",
            "- sends: no",
            "",
        ])
    )
    sys.exit(4)

try:
    request = json.loads(request_path.read_text())
except json.JSONDecodeError:
    request = {"id": request_id}

(out_dir / "request.json").write_text(json.dumps(request, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

result_path = root / "runs" / request_id / "result.json"
review_output_path = root / "runs" / request_id / "review_output.txt"
result = {}
if result_path.exists():
    try:
        result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        result = {}
    shutil.copyfile(result_path, out_dir / "result.json")
if review_output_path.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(review_output_path, out_dir / "review_output.txt")
review_summary = summarize_review(result, read_review_output(review_output_path))

summary.update({
    "found": True,
    "status": found_state or "",
    "queue_state": request_path.parent.name,
    "request_path": str(request_path),
    "result_path": str(result_path) if result_path.exists() else "",
    "review_output_path": str(review_output_path) if review_output_path.exists() else "",
    "proof_path": str(root / "runs" / request_id) if (root / "runs" / request_id).exists() else "",
    "commit_sha": request.get("commit_sha") or request.get("submitted_head") or "",
    "submitted_head": request.get("submitted_head") or "",
    "pr_url": request.get("pr_url") or "",
    "operator_id": request.get("operator_id") or "legacy_missing",
    "review_result": result.get("review_result") or "",
    "review_clean": review_summary["review_clean"],
    "review_finding_count": review_summary["review_finding_count"],
    "review_summary": review_summary["review_summary"],
    "review_summary_source": review_summary["review_summary_source"],
    "exit_code": result.get("exit_code"),
    "wall_s": result.get("wall_s"),
})
(out_dir / "REQUEST_STATUS.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

def value_or_missing(value):
    return value if value not in (None, "") else "missing"

request_json_name = "request.json" if request_path.exists() else "missing"
result_json_name = "result.json" if result_path.exists() else "missing"
review_output_name = "review_output.txt" if review_output_path.exists() else "missing"

(out_dir / "PROOF.md").write_text(
    "\n".join([
        "# Spark OpenClaw Request Status Proof",
        "",
        "- lane: spark-openclaw-autoreview",
        "- host: spark-2",
        f"- run_id: {run_id}",
        f"- request_id: {request_id}",
        "- operator_id: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["operator_id"])),
        "- expected_operator_id: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["expected_operator_id"])),
        f"- queue_root: {root}",
        f"- queue_state: {request_path.parent.name}",
        "- result: {}".format(summary["status"]),
        "- commit_sha: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["commit_sha"])),
        "- pr_url: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["pr_url"])),
        "- review_result: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["review_result"])),
        "- review_summary: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["review_summary"])),
        "- review_clean: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["review_clean"])),
        "- review_finding_count: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["review_finding_count"])),
        "- review_summary_source: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["review_summary_source"])),
        "- exit_code: {}".format(value_or_missing(summary["exit_code"])),
        f"- request_json: {request_json_name}",
        f"- result_json: {result_json_name}",
        f"- review_output: {review_output_name}",
        "- summary_json: REQUEST_STATUS.json",
        "- secrets_inspected: no",
        "- edits: no",
        "- deploys: no",
        "- sends: no",
        "",
        "This is a read-only fetch of an existing Spark-owned OpenClaw queue request.",
        "It does not submit a new review, drain the queue, restart services, or edit the reviewed worktree.",
        "",
    ])
)
PY
'
  request_status_errexit=0
  case "$-" in *e*) request_status_errexit=1; set +e ;; esac
  status_out="$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -- "$TARGET" "bash -s -- $(printf '%q' "$REQUEST_ID") $(printf '%q' "$QUEUE_STATE") $(printf '%q' "$run_id") $(printf '%q' "$DRY") $(printf '%q' "$OPERATOR_ID")" <<<"$request_status_script" 2>&1)"
  status_rc=$?
  [ "$request_status_errexit" = "0" ] || set -e
  printf '%s\n' "$status_out" >&2

  if [ "$DRY" = "1" ]; then
    if [ "$status_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="launch_only"
      lane_emit dry "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request status fetch validated on $TARGET; request_id=$REQUEST_ID" ""
      exit 0
    fi
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request status dry probe failed rc=$status_rc" "see stderr"
    exit 3
  fi

  rsync -az -- "$TARGET:~/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-request-status-runs/$run_id/" "$local_dir/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  proof_rel="runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id/PROOF.md"
  status_file="$local_dir/REQUEST_STATUS.json"
  if [ ! -f "$status_file" ]; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request status fetch failed rc=$status_rc" "missing REQUEST_STATUS.json"
    exit 3
  fi
  if [ ! -f "$local_dir/PROOF.md" ]; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request status fetch failed rc=$status_rc" "missing PROOF.md"
    exit 3
  fi

  request_status="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("status") or "")' "$status_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  request_commit="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("commit_sha") or "")' "$status_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  request_pr="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("pr_url") or "")' "$status_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [ -n "$PR_URL" ] || PR_URL="$request_pr"

  case "$request_status" in
    completed)
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
      LANE_TERMINAL_PROOF="$proof_rel"
      lane_emit completed "$proof_rel" "$request_commit" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request $REQUEST_ID completed on $TARGET" ""
      exit 0
      ;;
    needs-human)
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
      LANE_TERMINAL_PROOF="$proof_rel"
      lane_emit needs-human "$proof_rel" "$request_commit" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request $REQUEST_ID needs human adjudication on $TARGET" "classify findings before routing fixes"
      exit 3
      ;;
    failed)
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
      LANE_TERMINAL_PROOF="$proof_rel"
      lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "$request_commit" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request $REQUEST_ID failed on $TARGET" "see $proof_rel"
      exit 3
      ;;
    queued|running)
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="packet_ready"
      lane_emit "$request_status" "$proof_rel" "$request_commit" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request $REQUEST_ID is $request_status on $TARGET" "request not terminal yet"
      exit 0
      ;;
    not-found)
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
      lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "$request_commit" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request $REQUEST_ID not found on $TARGET" "status=not-found"
      exit 3
      ;;
    *)
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
      lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "$request_commit" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview request $REQUEST_ID status unknown on $TARGET" "status=$request_status"
      exit 3
      ;;
  esac
fi

if [ "$QUEUE_STATUS" = "1" ]; then
  queue_status_script='
set -u
queue_state="$1"
run_id="$2"
dry="$3"
operator_id="${4:-}"
root="${queue_state:-$HOME/.local/state/openclaw-review}"

[ -d "$root" ] || { echo "spark-openclaw-queue-status: queue root not found: $root" >&2; exit 21; }
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "spark-openclaw-queue-status: missing python3" >&2; exit 22; }

if [ "$dry" = "1" ]; then
  printf "queue_root=%s\n" "$root"
  printf "operator_id=%s\n" "$operator_id"
  exit 0
fi

out_dir="$HOME/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-queue-status-runs/$run_id"
mkdir -p "$out_dir"
ROOT="$root" OUT_DIR="$out_dir" RUN_ID="$run_id" OPERATOR_ID="$operator_id" python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["ROOT"])
out_dir = Path(os.environ["OUT_DIR"])
run_id = os.environ["RUN_ID"]
operator_filter = os.environ.get("OPERATOR_ID") or ""
operator_label = operator_filter or "all"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def read_review_output(path):
    if not path.exists():
        return ""
    try:
        return path.read_text(errors="replace")
    except OSError:
        return ""

def summarize_review(result, review_output):
    raw_result = result.get("review_result") or ""
    exit_code = result.get("exit_code")
    exit_code_text = str(exit_code) if exit_code is not None else ""

    def raw_finding_count():
        lowered = raw_result.lower()
        for pattern in (
            r"\b(\d+)\s+(?:accepted\s+)?(?:actionable\s+)?findings?\b",
            r"\bfindings?\s*[:=]\s*(\d+)\b",
        ):
            match = re.search(pattern, lowered)
            if match:
                return int(match.group(1))
        return None

    def output_finding_count():
        clean_pattern = r"no (?:accepted/actionable |actionable |accepted )?findings reported\.?"
        for line in review_output.splitlines():
            normalized = re.sub(r"^[-*]\s+", "", line.strip().lower())
            if not normalized:
                continue
            match = re.match(r"autoreview findings:\s*(\d+)\b", normalized)
            if match:
                return int(match.group(1))
            if re.fullmatch(clean_pattern, normalized):
                return 0
        return None

    finding_count = output_finding_count()
    source = "review_output" if finding_count is not None else "unknown"
    if finding_count is None:
        finding_count = raw_finding_count()
        source = "review_result" if finding_count is not None else "unknown"

    if exit_code_text and exit_code_text not in {"0", "1"}:
        return {
            "review_clean": None,
            "review_finding_count": None,
            "review_summary": f"unknown; run failed (exit {exit_code_text})",
            "review_summary_source": "exit_code",
        }

    if exit_code_text in {"0", "1"}:
        exit_clean = exit_code_text == "0"
        if finding_count is not None and (finding_count == 0) != exit_clean:
            return {
                "review_clean": None,
                "review_finding_count": finding_count,
                "review_summary": f"conflict; exit_code={exit_code_text}, text={finding_count} findings",
                "review_summary_source": f"{source}+exit_code",
            }
        if exit_clean:
            count = finding_count if finding_count is not None else 0
            return {
                "review_clean": True,
                "review_finding_count": count,
                "review_summary": f"clean; {count} findings",
                "review_summary_source": source if finding_count is not None else "exit_code",
            }
        count_text = finding_count if finding_count is not None else "unknown"
        return {
            "review_clean": False,
            "review_finding_count": finding_count,
            "review_summary": f"actionable; {count_text} findings",
            "review_summary_source": source if finding_count is not None else "exit_code",
        }

    if finding_count is not None:
        clean = finding_count == 0
        if clean:
            review_summary = f"clean; {finding_count} findings"
        else:
            review_summary = f"actionable; {finding_count} findings"
    else:
        clean = None
        review_summary = "unknown"
    return {
        "review_clean": clean,
        "review_finding_count": finding_count,
        "review_summary": review_summary,
        "review_summary_source": source,
    }

state_dirs = [
    ("requests", "queued"),
    ("running", "running"),
    ("needs-human", "needs-human"),
    ("done", "completed"),
    ("failed", "failed"),
]
status_order = ["queued", "running", "needs-human", "completed", "failed"]
items = []
unfiltered_count = 0

for dirname, status in state_dirs:
    folder = root / dirname
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("*.json")) if folder.exists() else []:
        try:
            raw = path.read_text()
        except OSError:
            continue
        unfiltered_count += 1
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            data = {"id": path.stem}
        item_operator = data.get("operator_id") or "legacy_missing"
        if operator_filter and item_operator != operator_filter:
            continue
        item_id = data.get("id") or path.stem
        item = {
            "id": item_id,
            "status": status,
            "queue_state": dirname,
            "path": str(path),
            "operator_id": item_operator,
            "repo": data.get("repo") or "",
            "mode": data.get("mode") or "",
            "engine": data.get("engine") or "",
            "model": data.get("model") or "",
            "reviewers": data.get("reviewers") or "",
            "source": data.get("source") or "",
            "pr_url": data.get("pr_url") or "",
            "commit_sha": data.get("commit_sha") or data.get("submitted_head") or "",
            "submitted_head": data.get("submitted_head") or "",
            "submitted_at_utc": data.get("submitted_at_utc") or "",
        }
        result_path = root / "runs" / item_id / "result.json"
        review_output_path = root / "runs" / item_id / "review_output.txt"
        proof_path = root / "runs" / item_id
        result = {}
        if result_path.exists():
            try:
                result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
            except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                result = {}
            item["review_result"] = result.get("review_result") or ""
            item["exit_code"] = result.get("exit_code")
            item["wall_s"] = result.get("wall_s")
            item["result_path"] = str(result_path)
        review_output = read_review_output(review_output_path)
        if review_output_path.exists():
            item["review_output_path"] = str(review_output_path)
        if proof_path.exists():
            item["proof_path"] = str(proof_path)
        item.update(summarize_review(result, review_output))
        items.append(item)

counts = {status: sum(1 for item in items if item["status"] == status) for status in status_order}
by_operator = {}
for item in items:
    by_operator[item["operator_id"]] = by_operator.get(item["operator_id"], 0) + 1

summary = {
    "schema": "spark_openclaw_queue_status.v1",
    "lane": "spark-openclaw-autoreview",
    "host": "spark-2",
    "run_id": run_id,
    "queue_root": str(root),
    "operator_id": operator_filter,
    "filtered": bool(operator_filter),
    "count": len(items),
    "unfiltered_count": unfiltered_count,
    "counts": counts,
    "operators": by_operator,
    "items": items,
}
(out_dir / "QUEUE_STATUS.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
(out_dir / "STATE.md").write_text(
    "\n".join([
        "# Spark OpenClaw Queue Status State",
        "",
        "status: completed",
        f"run_id: {run_id}",
        f"queue_root: {root}",
        f"operator_id: {operator_label}",
        f"count: {len(items)}",
        f"unfiltered_count: {unfiltered_count}",
        "",
    ])
)

proof_lines = [
    "# Spark OpenClaw Queue Status Proof",
    "",
    "- lane: spark-openclaw-autoreview",
    "- host: spark-2",
    f"- run_id: {run_id}",
    f"- queue_root: {root}",
    "- operator_id: {}".format(operator_filter or "all"),
    "- result: completed",
    "- queue_status_json: QUEUE_STATUS.json",
    "- state: STATE.md",
    "- filtered_count: {}".format(len(items)),
    "- unfiltered_count: {}".format(unfiltered_count),
]
for status in status_order:
    proof_lines.append("- {}: {}".format(status, counts.get(status, 0)))
proof_lines.extend([
    "- secrets_inspected: no",
    "- edits: no",
    "- deploys: no",
    "- sends: no",
    "- watcher_restarted: no",
    "- model_launched: no",
    "",
    "This is a read-only summary of Spark-2 OpenClaw queue request metadata.",
    "It does not submit a review, drain the queue, restart services, launch a model, or edit reviewed worktrees.",
    "",
])
(out_dir / "PROOF.md").write_text("\n".join(proof_lines))
PY
'
  queue_status_errexit=0
  case "$-" in *e*) queue_status_errexit=1; set +e ;; esac
  status_out="$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -- "$TARGET" "bash -s -- $(printf '%q' "$QUEUE_STATE") $(printf '%q' "$run_id") $(printf '%q' "$DRY") $(printf '%q' "$OPERATOR_ID")" <<<"$queue_status_script" 2>&1)"
  status_rc=$?
  [ "$queue_status_errexit" = "0" ] || set -e
  printf '%s\n' "$status_out" >&2

  if [ "$DRY" = "1" ]; then
    if [ "$status_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="launch_only"
      lane_emit dry "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview queue status validated on $TARGET; operator_id=${OPERATOR_ID:-all}" ""
      exit 0
    fi
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview queue status dry probe failed rc=$status_rc" "see stderr"
    exit 3
  fi

  rsync -az -- "$TARGET:~/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-queue-status-runs/$run_id/" "$local_dir/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  proof_rel="runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id/PROOF.md"
  status_file="$local_dir/QUEUE_STATUS.json"
  if [ "$status_rc" -ne 0 ] || [ ! -f "$status_file" ] || [ ! -f "$local_dir/PROOF.md" ]; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview queue status failed rc=$status_rc" "missing queue status proof"
    exit 3
  fi
  status_count="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("count") or 0)' "$status_file" 2>/dev/null || printf '0')"
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
  LANE_TERMINAL_PROOF="$proof_rel"
  lane_emit completed "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview queue status fetched on $TARGET; operator_id=${OPERATOR_ID:-all}; count=$status_count" ""
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT" = "1" ]; then
  activation_preflight_script='
set -u
run_id="$1"
queue_state="$2"
dry="$3"
repo="$HOME/Developer/spark-dgx"
lane="$repo/lanes/openclaw-review"
install_script="$lane/systemd/install.sh"

  command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "spark-openclaw-activation-preflight: missing python3" >&2; exit 22; }
  [ -x "$install_script" ] || { echo "spark-openclaw-activation-preflight: missing installer $install_script" >&2; exit 23; }
  "$install_script" --dry-run >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "spark-openclaw-activation-preflight: install dry-run failed" >&2; exit 24; }
  command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "spark-openclaw-activation-preflight: missing systemctl" >&2; exit 25; }
  printf "activation_preflight=ready_human_gated\n"
  printf "installer=%s\n" "$install_script"
  exit 0
