out_dir="$HOME/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-activation-preflight-runs/$run_id"
mkdir -p "$out_dir"
QUEUE_STATE="$queue_state" RUN_ID="$run_id" OUT_DIR="$out_dir" python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

home = Path.home()
run_id = os.environ["RUN_ID"]
out_dir = Path(os.environ["OUT_DIR"])
queue_state = os.environ.get("QUEUE_STATE") or ""
repo = home / "Developer" / "spark-dgx"
lane = repo / "lanes" / "openclaw-review"
queue_root = Path(queue_state) if queue_state else home / ".local" / "state" / "openclaw-review"
service_name = "openclaw-review-watch.service"

paths = {
    "repo": repo,
    "lane": lane,
    "runner": lane / "autoreview-run.sh",
    "requester": lane / "autoreview-request.sh",
    "watcher": lane / "autoreview-watch.sh",
    "heartbeat": lane / "heartbeat-post.sh",
    "installer": lane / "systemd" / "install.sh",
    "source_unit": lane / "systemd" / service_name,
    "installed_unit": home / ".config" / "systemd" / "user" / service_name,
    "installed_watcher": home / ".local" / "bin" / "autoreview-watch.sh",
    "installed_runner": home / ".local" / "bin" / "autoreview-run.sh",
}

def executable(path: Path) -> bool:
    return path.exists() and os.access(path, os.X_OK)

required_exec = ["runner", "requester", "watcher", "heartbeat", "installer"]
required_files = ["source_unit"]
missing_required = [
    name for name in required_exec if not executable(paths[name])
] + [
    name for name in required_files if not paths[name].exists()
]

def run_readonly(cmd: list[str], timeout: int = 10) -> dict:
    def text_or_empty(value) -> str:
        if isinstance(value, bytes):
            return value.decode(errors="replace")
        return value or ""

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            text=True,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            timeout=timeout,
            check=False,
        )
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {"available": False, "rc": None, "stdout": "", "stderr": "command not found"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        stderr = text_or_empty(exc.stderr)
        if stderr:
            stderr += "\n"
        stderr += "timeout"
        return {
            "available": True,
            "rc": 124,
            "stdout": text_or_empty(exc.stdout),
            "stderr": stderr,
        }
    return {
        "available": True,
        "rc": result.returncode,
        "stdout": result.stdout.strip(),
        "stderr": result.stderr.strip(),
    }

install_stdout = out_dir / "install-dry-run.txt"
install_stderr = out_dir / "install-dry-run.stderr"
if executable(paths["installer"]):
    install = run_readonly([str(paths["installer"]), "--dry-run"], timeout=20)
else:
    install = {"available": False, "rc": None, "stdout": "", "stderr": "installer missing or not executable"}
install_stdout.write_text((install.get("stdout") or "") + "\n")
install_stderr.write_text((install.get("stderr") or "") + "\n")

systemctl_available = shutil.which("systemctl") is not None
service_active = run_readonly(["systemctl", "--user", "is-active", service_name]) if systemctl_available else {"available": False, "rc": None, "stdout": "unknown", "stderr": "systemctl missing"}
service_enabled = run_readonly(["systemctl", "--user", "is-enabled", service_name]) if systemctl_available else {"available": False, "rc": None, "stdout": "unknown", "stderr": "systemctl missing"}
show_user = run_readonly(["loginctl", "show-user", os.environ.get("USER", ""), "-p", "Linger"]) if shutil.which("loginctl") else {"available": False, "rc": None, "stdout": "unknown", "stderr": "loginctl missing"}

queue_dirs = ["requests", "running", "needs-human", "done", "failed", "runs"]
queue_counts = {}
for dirname in queue_dirs:
    folder = queue_root / dirname
    if folder.exists():
        queue_counts[dirname] = len(list(folder.glob("*.json"))) if dirname != "runs" else len([p for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_dir()])
    else:
        queue_counts[dirname] = None

source_ready = not missing_required
install_dry_run_ok = install.get("rc") == 0
service_manager_ready = systemctl_available
activation_ready = source_ready and install_dry_run_ok and service_manager_ready
service_state = {
    "systemctl_available": systemctl_available,
    "active": service_active.get("stdout") or "unknown",
    "active_rc": service_active.get("rc"),
    "enabled": service_enabled.get("stdout") or "unknown",
    "enabled_rc": service_enabled.get("rc"),
    "installed_unit_present": paths["installed_unit"].exists(),
    "installed_watcher_present": paths["installed_watcher"].exists(),
    "installed_runner_present": paths["installed_runner"].exists(),
    "linger": show_user.get("stdout") or "unknown",
    "linger_rc": show_user.get("rc"),
}
status_label = "ready-human-gated" if activation_ready else "blocked"
missing_required_label = "none" if not missing_required else ", ".join(missing_required)
service_active_label = service_state["active"]
service_enabled_label = service_state["enabled"]
installed_unit_present = str(service_state["installed_unit_present"]).lower()
queue_root_exists = str(queue_root.exists()).lower()

summary = {
    "schema": "spark_openclaw_activation_preflight.v1",
    "lane": "spark-openclaw-autoreview",
    "host": "spark-2",
    "run_id": run_id,
    "source_repo": str(repo),
    "queue_root": str(queue_root),
    "paths": {name: str(path) for name, path in paths.items()},
    "missing_required": missing_required,
    "source_ready": source_ready,
    "install_dry_run_ok": install_dry_run_ok,
    "install_dry_run_stdout": "install-dry-run.txt",
    "install_dry_run_stderr": "install-dry-run.stderr",
    "service_manager_ready": service_manager_ready,
    "service_state": service_state,
    "queue_root_exists": queue_root.exists(),
    "queue_counts": queue_counts,
    "activation_ready": activation_ready,
    "human_gate_remaining": "service install/refresh requires explicit Bobby approval",
    "service_mutation_performed": False,
    "service_reload_performed": False,
    "service_restart_performed": False,
    "service_enable_performed": False,
    "env_file_inspected": False,
    "secrets_inspected": False,
    "model_launched": False,
    "review_submitted": False,
    "watcher_drained": False,
    "allowed_next_action_after_gate": "lanes/openclaw-review/systemd/install.sh --yes on Spark-2, then submit one queued request and fetch terminal status",
}
(out_dir / "ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
(out_dir / "STATE.md").write_text(
    "\n".join([
        "# Spark OpenClaw Activation Preflight State",
        "",
        f"status: {status_label}",
        f"run_id: {run_id}",
        f"source_ready: {str(source_ready).lower()}",
        f"install_dry_run_ok: {str(install_dry_run_ok).lower()}",
        f"service_manager_ready: {str(service_manager_ready).lower()}",
        f"service_active: {service_active_label}",
        f"service_enabled: {service_enabled_label}",
        "human_gate_remaining: service install/refresh requires explicit Bobby approval",
        "",
    ])
)

proof = [
    "# Spark OpenClaw Activation Preflight Proof",
    "",
    "- lane: spark-openclaw-autoreview",
    "- host: spark-2",
    f"- run_id: {run_id}",
    f"- queue_root: {queue_root}",
    f"- result: {status_label}",
    f"- source_ready: {str(source_ready).lower()}",
    f"- missing_required: {missing_required_label}",
    f"- install_dry_run_ok: {str(install_dry_run_ok).lower()}",
    "- install_dry_run_stdout: install-dry-run.txt",
    "- install_dry_run_stderr: install-dry-run.stderr",
    f"- systemctl_available: {str(systemctl_available).lower()}",
    f"- service_active: {service_active_label}",
    f"- service_enabled: {service_enabled_label}",
    f"- installed_unit_present: {installed_unit_present}",
    f"- queue_root_exists: {queue_root_exists}",
    "- activation_preflight_json: ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT.json",
    "- state: STATE.md",
    "- service_mutation_performed: no",
    "- service_reload_performed: no",
    "- service_restart_performed: no",
    "- service_enable_performed: no",
    "- env_file_inspected: no",
    "- secrets_inspected: no",
    "- model_launched: no",
    "- review_submitted: no",
    "- watcher_drained: no",
    "- human_gate_remaining: service install/refresh requires explicit Bobby approval",
    "",
    "This preflight is read-only except for writing this proof packet.",
    "It previews the Spark-side systemd installer with --dry-run and records whether the source/service prerequisites are ready for a later human-approved activation.",
    "",
]
(out_dir / "PROOF.md").write_text("\n".join(proof))
raise SystemExit(0 if activation_ready else 3)
PY
'
  activation_errexit=0
  case "$-" in *e*) activation_errexit=1; set +e ;; esac
  status_out="$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -- "$TARGET" "bash -s -- $(printf '%q' "$run_id") $(printf '%q' "$QUEUE_STATE") $(printf '%q' "$DRY")" <<<"$activation_preflight_script" 2>&1)"
  status_rc=$?
  [ "$activation_errexit" = "0" ] || set -e
  printf '%s\n' "$status_out" >&2

  if [ "$DRY" = "1" ]; then
    if [ "$status_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
      LANE_PROOF_STATUS="launch_only"
      lane_emit dry "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview activation preflight dry validated on $TARGET" "service activation remains human-gated"
      exit 0
    fi
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview activation preflight dry failed rc=$status_rc" "see stderr"
    exit 3
  fi

  rsync -az -- "$TARGET:~/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-activation-preflight-runs/$run_id/" "$local_dir/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  proof_rel="runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id/PROOF.md"
  preflight_file="$local_dir/ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT.json"
  if [ ! -f "$preflight_file" ] || [ ! -f "$local_dir/PROOF.md" ]; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview activation preflight failed rc=$status_rc" "missing activation preflight proof"
    exit 3
  fi
  activation_ready="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print("yes" if json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("activation_ready") else "no")' "$preflight_file" 2>/dev/null || printf 'no')"
  LANE_TERMINAL_PROOF="$proof_rel"
  if [ "$activation_ready" = "yes" ]; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
    lane_emit completed "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview activation preflight ready on $TARGET" "service activation remains human-gated"
    exit 0
  fi
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
  lane_emit needs-human "$proof_rel" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview activation preflight blocked on $TARGET" "inspect ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT.json before requesting service activation"
  exit 3
fi

REMOTE_AGENT_SKILLS_DIR="${SPARK_OPENCLAW_AGENT_SKILLS_DIR:-}"
remote_agent_skills_prefix=""
if [ -n "$REMOTE_AGENT_SKILLS_DIR" ]; then
  if [ "$QUEUE" = "1" ]; then
    echo "run.sh: SPARK_OPENCLAW_AGENT_SKILLS_DIR is not supported with --queue; update the Spark watcher contract or use --watch-once/direct proof" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  remote_agent_skills_prefix="AGENT_SKILLS_DIR=$(printf '%q' "$REMOTE_AGENT_SKILLS_DIR") "
fi

probe_script='
set -u
worktree="$1"
engine="$2"
reviewers="$3"
watch_once="$4"
queue_state="${5:-}"
runner="$HOME/Developer/spark-dgx/lanes/openclaw-review/autoreview-run.sh"
requester="$HOME/Developer/spark-dgx/lanes/openclaw-review/autoreview-request.sh"
watcher="$HOME/Developer/spark-dgx/lanes/openclaw-review/autoreview-watch.sh"
skills="${AGENT_SKILLS_DIR:-}"
if [ -n "$skills" ]; then
  [ -x "$skills/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview" ] || exit 15
else
  for candidate in "$HOME/Developer/repos/openclaw/agent-skills" "$HOME/Developer/agent-skills"; do
    if [ -x "$candidate/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview" ]; then
      skills="$candidate"
      break
    fi
  done
fi
command -v bash >/dev/null || exit 12
[ -x "$runner" ] || exit 13
[ -x "$requester" ] || exit 19
[ "$watch_once" != "1" ] || [ -x "$watcher" ] || exit 20
if [ "$watch_once" != "1" ]; then
  command -v git >/dev/null || exit 11
  git -C "$worktree" rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 14
else
  [ -d "$queue_state" ] || { echo "spark-openclaw-watch-once: queue root not found: $queue_state" >&2; exit 21; }
fi
[ -n "$skills" ] || exit 15
[ -x "$skills/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview" ] || exit 16
requested="$engine"
[ -n "$reviewers" ] && requested="$(printf "%s" "$reviewers" | tr "," " ")"
needs_cli_bootstrap=0
for tool in $requested; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || needs_cli_bootstrap=1
done
if [ "$needs_cli_bootstrap" = "1" ] && [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then
  export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
  . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  nvm use --silent default >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use --silent node >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
for tool in $requested; do
  case "$tool" in
    codex|claude) ;;
    *) exit 18 ;;
  esac
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 17
done
printf "runner=%s\n" "$runner"
printf "requester=%s\n" "$requester"
printf "watcher=%s\n" "$watcher"
printf "agent_skills_dir=%s\n" "$skills"
printf "requested_reviewers=%s\n" "$requested"
if [ "$watch_once" != "1" ]; then
  printf "worktree=%s\n" "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
  printf "head=%s\n" "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse --short HEAD)"
  printf "head_full=%s\n" "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse HEAD)"
else
  printf "worktree=%s\n" ""
  printf "head=%s\n" ""
  printf "head_full=%s\n" ""
fi
'

probe_out="$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -- "$TARGET" "${remote_agent_skills_prefix}bash -s -- $(printf '%q' "$REMOTE_WORKTREE") $(printf '%q' "$ENGINE") $(printf '%q' "$REVIEWERS") $(printf '%q' "$WATCH_ONCE") $(printf '%q' "$QUEUE_STATE")" <<<"$probe_script" 2>&1)"
probe_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$probe_out" >&2

if [ "$probe_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  probe_blocker="ssh/runner/helper/worktree/tool probe failed"
  case "$probe_out" in
    *"Host key verification failed."*)
      probe_blocker="spark_ssh_host_key_blocked: run from CP-1 or provision the operator terminal's spark-2 SSH alias/trust"
      ;;
    *"Permission denied"*)
      probe_blocker="spark_ssh_auth_blocked: run from CP-1 or provision Spark-2 SSH auth for this operator terminal"
      ;;
    *"spark-openclaw-watch-once: queue root not found:"*)
      probe_blocker="spark_openclaw_queue_root_missing: check --queue-state path on Spark-2"
      ;;
  esac
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
  lane_emit failed "" "" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview dry probe failed rc=$probe_rc" "$probe_blocker"
  exit 3
fi

RESOLVED_RUNNER="$(printf '%s\n' "$probe_out" | awk -F= '/^runner=/{print $2; exit}')"
RESOLVED_REQUESTER="$(printf '%s\n' "$probe_out" | awk -F= '/^requester=/{print $2; exit}')"
RESOLVED_WATCHER="$(printf '%s\n' "$probe_out" | awk -F= '/^watcher=/{print $2; exit}')"
RESOLVED_SKILLS="$(printf '%s\n' "$probe_out" | awk -F= '/^agent_skills_dir=/{print $2; exit}')"
RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL="$(printf '%s\n' "$probe_out" | awk -F= '/^head_full=/{print $2; exit}')"

if [ "$DRY" = "1" ]; then
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="launch_only"
  if [ "$QUEUE" = "1" ]; then
    lane_emit dry "" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview queue producer validated on $TARGET; worktree=$REMOTE_WORKTREE" ""
  elif [ "$WATCH_ONCE" = "1" ]; then
    lane_emit dry "" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview watcher validated on $TARGET; queue_state=$QUEUE_STATE" ""
  else
    lane_emit dry "" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview validated on $TARGET; worktree=$REMOTE_WORKTREE" ""
  fi
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$WATCH_ONCE" = "1" ]; then
  [ -n "$QUEUE_STATE" ] || { echo "run.sh: --watch-once requires --queue-state <spark-state-root>" >&2; exit 2; }
  watch_script='
set -u
watcher="$1"
queue_state="$2"
run_id="$3"
skills="$4"
out_dir="$HOME/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-watcher-once-runs/$run_id"
mkdir -p "$out_dir"
before="$out_dir/before.json"
after="$out_dir/after.json"
fairness="$out_dir/FAIRNESS.json"
stdout="$out_dir/watcher.stdout"
stderr="$out_dir/watcher.stderr"

[ -d "$queue_state" ] || { echo "spark-openclaw-watch-once: queue root not found: $queue_state" >&2; exit 21; }

snapshot() {
  root="$1" python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["root"])
states = {
    "requests": "queued",
    "running": "running",
    "done": "completed",
    "needs-human": "needs_human",
    "failed": "failed",
}
items = []

def read_review_output(path):
    if not path.exists():
        return ""
    try:
        return path.read_text(errors="replace")
    except OSError:
        return ""

def summarize_review(result, review_output):
    raw_result = result.get("review_result") or ""
    exit_code = result.get("exit_code")
    exit_code_text = str(exit_code) if exit_code is not None else ""

    def raw_finding_count():
        lowered = raw_result.lower()
        for pattern in (
            r"\b(\d+)\s+(?:accepted\s+)?(?:actionable\s+)?findings?\b",
            r"\bfindings?\s*[:=]\s*(\d+)\b",
        ):
            match = re.search(pattern, lowered)
            if match:
                return int(match.group(1))
        return None

    def output_finding_count():
        clean_pattern = r"no (?:accepted/actionable |actionable |accepted )?findings reported\.?"
        for line in review_output.splitlines():
            normalized = re.sub(r"^[-*]\s+", "", line.strip().lower())
            if not normalized:
                continue
            match = re.match(r"autoreview findings:\s*(\d+)\b", normalized)
            if match:
                return int(match.group(1))
            if re.fullmatch(clean_pattern, normalized):
                return 0
        return None

    finding_count = output_finding_count()
    source = "review_output" if finding_count is not None else "unknown"
    if finding_count is None:
        finding_count = raw_finding_count()
        source = "review_result" if finding_count is not None else "unknown"

    if exit_code_text and exit_code_text not in {"0", "1"}:
        return {
            "review_clean": None,
            "review_finding_count": None,
            "review_summary": f"unknown; run failed (exit {exit_code_text})",
            "review_summary_source": "exit_code",
        }

    if exit_code_text in {"0", "1"}:
        exit_clean = exit_code_text == "0"
        if finding_count is not None and (finding_count == 0) != exit_clean:
            return {
                "review_clean": None,
                "review_finding_count": finding_count,
                "review_summary": f"conflict; exit_code={exit_code_text}, text={finding_count} findings",
                "review_summary_source": f"{source}+exit_code",
            }
        if exit_clean:
            count = finding_count if finding_count is not None else 0
            return {
                "review_clean": True,
                "review_finding_count": count,
                "review_summary": f"clean; {count} findings",
                "review_summary_source": source if finding_count is not None else "exit_code",
            }
        count_text = finding_count if finding_count is not None else "unknown"
        return {
            "review_clean": False,
            "review_finding_count": finding_count,
            "review_summary": f"actionable; {count_text} findings",
            "review_summary_source": source if finding_count is not None else "exit_code",
        }

    if finding_count is not None:
        clean = finding_count == 0
        if clean:
            review_summary = f"clean; {finding_count} findings"
        else:
            review_summary = f"actionable; {finding_count} findings"
    else:
        clean = None
        review_summary = "unknown"
    return {
        "review_clean": clean,
        "review_finding_count": finding_count,
        "review_summary": review_summary,
        "review_summary_source": source,
    }

for dirname, status in states.items():
    folder = root / dirname
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("*.json")) if folder.exists() else []:
        try:
            raw = path.read_text()
        except OSError:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            data = {"id": path.stem}
        item = {
            "id": data.get("id") or path.stem,
            "status": status,
            "queue_state": dirname,
            "path": str(path),
            "repo": data.get("repo") or "",
            "engine": data.get("engine") or "",
            "reviewers": data.get("reviewers") or "",
            "source": data.get("source") or "",
            "pr_url": data.get("pr_url") or "",
            "operator_id": data.get("operator_id") or "legacy_missing",
            "commit_sha": data.get("commit_sha") or data.get("submitted_head") or "",
            "submitted_head": data.get("submitted_head") or "",
            "submitted_at_utc": data.get("submitted_at_utc") or "",
        }
        result_path = root / "runs" / item["id"] / "result.json"
        review_output_path = root / "runs" / item["id"] / "review_output.txt"
        result = {}
        if result_path.exists():
            try:
                result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
            except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                result = {}
            item["review_result"] = result.get("review_result") or ""
            item["exit_code"] = result.get("exit_code")
            item["wall_s"] = result.get("wall_s")
            item["proof_path"] = str(root / "runs" / item["id"])
        if review_output_path.exists():
            item["review_output_path"] = str(review_output_path)
        item.update(summarize_review(result, read_review_output(review_output_path)))
        items.append(item)
print(json.dumps({
    "root": str(root),
    "counts": {state: sum(1 for item in items if item["status"] == state) for state in sorted(set(states.values()))},
    "items": items,
}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
PY
}

snapshot "$queue_state" > "$before"
OPENCLAW_REVIEW_STATE="$queue_state" AGENT_SKILLS_DIR="$skills" "$watcher" --once > "$stdout" 2> "$stderr"
rc=$?
snapshot "$queue_state" > "$after"
terminal_status="$(python3 - "$before" "$after" "$stderr" "$fairness" <<'PY'
import json
import re
import sys

before = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
after = json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
stderr_path = sys.argv[3]
fairness_path = sys.argv[4]
counts = after.get("counts") or {}
before_items = before.get("items") or []
after_items = after.get("items") or []
before_status_by_id = {item.get("id"): item.get("status") for item in before_items}
before_by_id = {item.get("id"): item for item in before_items}
after_by_id = {item.get("id"): item for item in after_items}
before_queued_ids = [item.get("id") for item in before_items if item.get("status") == "queued" and item.get("id")]
terminal_statuses = {"failed", "needs_human", "completed"}
completed_or_transitioned_terminal = []
terminal_by_id = {}
for item in after.get("items") or []:
    item_id = item.get("id")
    status = item.get("status")
    before_status = before_status_by_id.get(item_id)
    if status not in terminal_statuses:
        continue
    if item_id not in before_status_by_id or before_status in {"queued", "running"}:
        completed_or_transitioned_terminal.append(item)
    if item_id in before_queued_ids:
        terminal_by_id[item_id] = status
terminal_statuses_after_watch = {item.get("status") for item in completed_or_transitioned_terminal}

claim_events = []
running_order = []
terminal_order = []
serialized_claim_log = True
open_running = None
try:
    lines = open(stderr_path, errors="replace").read().splitlines()
except OSError:
    lines = []
for line in lines:
    running_match = re.search(r"\b(req-[A-Za-z0-9T._:-]+): running autoreview\b", line)
    terminal_match = re.search(r"\b(req-[A-Za-z0-9T._:-]+): (done|needs-human|failed) rc=", line)
    missing_match = re.search(r"\b(req-[A-Za-z0-9T._:-]+): repo not found:", line)
    if running_match:
        item_id = running_match.group(1)
        if open_running is not None:
            serialized_claim_log = False
        open_running = item_id
        running_order.append(item_id)
        claim_events.append({"event": "running", "id": item_id, "line": line})
    elif terminal_match:
        item_id = terminal_match.group(1)
        status = terminal_match.group(2).replace("-", "_")
        if open_running not in (None, item_id):
            serialized_claim_log = False
        open_running = None
        terminal_order.append(item_id)
        claim_events.append({"event": status, "id": item_id, "line": line})
    elif missing_match:
        item_id = missing_match.group(1)
        if open_running not in (None, item_id):
            serialized_claim_log = False
        open_running = None
        terminal_order.append(item_id)
        claim_events.append({"event": "failed", "id": item_id, "line": line})
if open_running is not None:
    serialized_claim_log = False

lost_requests = [item_id for item_id in before_queued_ids if item_id not in after_by_id]
non_terminal_requests = [
    item_id for item_id in before_queued_ids
    if after_by_id.get(item_id, {}).get("status") not in terminal_statuses
]
operator_by_id = {
    item_id: (before_by_id.get(item_id, {}).get("operator_id") or "legacy_missing")
    for item_id in before_queued_ids
}
operators_preserved = all(
    (after_by_id.get(item_id, {}).get("operator_id") or "legacy_missing") == operator_by_id[item_id]
    for item_id in before_queued_ids
    if item_id in after_by_id
)
duplicate_claims = len(running_order) != len(set(running_order))
queued_requests_observed = bool(before_queued_ids)
running_order_set = set(running_order)
terminal_order_set = set(terminal_order)
claim_log_covers_queued_requests = all(item_id in running_order_set for item_id in before_queued_ids)
terminal_log_covers_queued_requests = all(item_id in terminal_order_set for item_id in before_queued_ids)
claim_log_supported = (
    not before_queued_ids
    or (
        bool(running_order)
        and claim_log_covers_queued_requests
        and terminal_log_covers_queued_requests
    )
)
if not claim_log_supported:
    serialized_claim_log = False
separator = chr(44) + chr(32)
fairness_ok = (
    queued_requests_observed
    and operators_preserved
    and not lost_requests
    and not non_terminal_requests
    and not duplicate_claims
    and claim_log_supported
    and serialized_claim_log
)

fairness = {
    "schema": "spark_openclaw_fair_queue_watch_once.v1",
    "before_queued_count": len(before_queued_ids),
    "before_queued_ids": before_queued_ids,
    "after_terminal_count": len(terminal_by_id),
    "terminal_by_id": terminal_by_id,
    "operator_by_id": operator_by_id,
    "operators_preserved": operators_preserved,
    "lost_requests": lost_requests,
    "non_terminal_requests": non_terminal_requests,
    "duplicate_claims": duplicate_claims,
    "queued_requests_observed": queued_requests_observed,
    "claim_log_covers_queued_requests": claim_log_covers_queued_requests,
    "terminal_log_covers_queued_requests": terminal_log_covers_queued_requests,
    "fairness_ok": fairness_ok,
    "claim_log_supported": claim_log_supported,
    "serialized_claim_log": serialized_claim_log,
    "running_order": running_order,
    "terminal_order": terminal_order,
    "claim_events": claim_events,
}
with open(fairness_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(fairness, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
with open(fairness_path.replace(".json", ".md"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write("\n".join([
        "# Spark OpenClaw Fair Queue Summary",
        "",
        f"- before_queued_count: {len(before_queued_ids)}",
        f"- after_terminal_count: {len(terminal_by_id)}",
        f"- operators_preserved: {str(operators_preserved).lower()}",
        f"- lost_requests: {len(lost_requests)}",
        f"- non_terminal_requests: {len(non_terminal_requests)}",
        f"- duplicate_claims: {str(duplicate_claims).lower()}",
        f"- queued_requests_observed: {str(queued_requests_observed).lower()}",
        f"- claim_log_covers_queued_requests: {str(claim_log_covers_queued_requests).lower()}",
        f"- terminal_log_covers_queued_requests: {str(terminal_log_covers_queued_requests).lower()}",
        f"- fairness_ok: {str(fairness_ok).lower()}",
        f"- claim_log_supported: {str(claim_log_supported).lower()}",
        f"- serialized_claim_log: {str(serialized_claim_log).lower()}",
        "- running_order: {}".format(separator.join(running_order) if running_order else "none"),
        "- terminal_order: {}".format(separator.join(terminal_order) if terminal_order else "none"),
        "",
    ]))

if not fairness_ok:
    print("fairness-failed")
elif "failed" in terminal_statuses_after_watch:
    print("failed")
elif "needs_human" in terminal_statuses_after_watch:
    print("needs-human")
elif int(counts.get("queued") or 0) or int(counts.get("running") or 0):
    print("not-drained")
else:
    print("completed")
PY
)"
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$terminal_status" != "completed" ]; then
  rc=1
fi
fairness_verdict="$(python3 - "$fairness" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

try:
    data = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
    print("Fairness verdict unavailable; inspect FAIRNESS.md and FAIRNESS.json before promotion.")
    raise SystemExit(0)

checks = [
    ("queued_requests_observed", data.get("queued_requests_observed") is True),
    ("operators_preserved", data.get("operators_preserved") is True),
    ("lost_requests", not bool(data.get("lost_requests"))),
    ("non_terminal_requests", not bool(data.get("non_terminal_requests"))),
    ("duplicate_claims", data.get("duplicate_claims") is False),
    ("claim_log_covers_queued_requests", data.get("claim_log_covers_queued_requests") is True),
    ("terminal_log_covers_queued_requests", data.get("terminal_log_covers_queued_requests") is True),
    ("claim_log_supported", data.get("claim_log_supported") is True),
    ("serialized_claim_log", data.get("serialized_claim_log") is True),
]
failed = [name for name, ok in checks if not ok]
if data.get("fairness_ok") is True:
    print("FAIRNESS.json reports queued requests observed, preserved operators, no lost or non-terminal queued requests, no duplicate claims, per-request claim logs, per-request terminal logs, and serialized watcher claims.")
else:
    print("FAIRNESS.json reports fairness concerns: " + ", ".join(failed) + ". Inspect FAIRNESS.md and FAIRNESS.json before promotion.")
PY
)"
cat > "$out_dir/PROOF.md" <<PROOF
# Spark OpenClaw Watcher Once Proof

- lane: spark-openclaw-autoreview
- host: spark-2
- run_id: $run_id
- queue_state: $queue_state
- watcher: $watcher
- agent_skills_dir: $skills
- result: $terminal_status
- exit_code: $rc
- before: before.json
- after: after.json
- fairness_json: FAIRNESS.json
- fairness_summary: FAIRNESS.md
- stdout: watcher.stdout
- stderr: watcher.stderr
- secrets_inspected: no
- edits: no
- deploys: no
- customer_sends: no
- heartbeat_posts: spark_watcher_default

The Spark watcher made one bounded pass over the isolated queue state.
$fairness_verdict
Review model output, if any, remains in the Spark-owned runtime proof root.
The watcher may emit its normal internal openclaw-review heartbeat/webhook
events; it does not send customer or non-test traffic.
PROOF
exit "$rc"
'
  watch_out="$(ssh -- "$TARGET" "bash -s -- $(printf '%q' "$RESOLVED_WATCHER") $(printf '%q' "$QUEUE_STATE") $(printf '%q' "$run_id") $(printf '%q' "$RESOLVED_SKILLS")" <<<"$watch_script" 2>&1)"
  watch_rc=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$watch_out" >&2
  rsync -az -- "$TARGET:~/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-watcher-once-runs/$run_id/" "$local_dir/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  proof_rel="runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id/PROOF.md"
  LANE_TERMINAL_PROOF="$proof_rel"
  if [ "$watch_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ -f "$proof_rel" ]; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
    lane_emit completed "$proof_rel" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview watcher drained queue_state=$QUEUE_STATE on $TARGET" ""
    exit 0
  fi
  if [ "$watch_rc" -eq 1 ] && [ -f "$proof_rel" ] && grep -q '^- result: needs-human$' "$proof_rel"; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
    lane_emit needs-human "$proof_rel" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview watcher drained to needs-human queue_state=$QUEUE_STATE on $TARGET" "classify findings before routing fixes"
    exit 3
  fi
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
  lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview watcher failed rc=$watch_rc on $TARGET" "see $proof_rel"
  exit 3
fi

if [ "$QUEUE" = "1" ]; then
  queue_script='
set -u
requester="$1"
worktree="$2"
mode="$3"
engine="$4"
reviewers="$5"
model="$6"
thinking="$7"
base="$8"
queue_state="$9"
pr_url="${10}"
commit_sha="${11}"
operator_id="${12}"
requested_id="${13}"

repo="$(cd "$worktree" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || { echo "spark-openclaw-queue: not a dir: $worktree" >&2; exit 2; }
submitted_head="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
root="${queue_state:-$HOME/.local/state/openclaw-review}"
req_dir="$root/requests"
mkdir -p "$req_dir"
id="${requested_id:-req-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$$RANDOM}"
tmp="$req_dir/.$id.$$.$RANDOM.json.tmp"
dest="$req_dir/$id.json"

# The Spark requester is still validated by the probe, but x-api writes the
# request atomically here so the queue artifact carries PR/commit identity
# before the Spark watcher can claim it.
[ -x "$requester" ] || { echo "spark-openclaw-queue: requester missing: $requester" >&2; exit 19; }
ID="$id" REPO="$repo" MODE="$mode" ENGINE="$engine" MODEL="$model" \
THINKING="$thinking" REVIEWERS="$reviewers" BASE="$base" \
SOURCE="x-api-spark-openclaw-autoreview" PR_URL="$pr_url" \
COMMIT_SHA="$commit_sha" SUBMITTED_HEAD="$submitted_head" OPERATOR_ID="$operator_id" TS="$(date +%s)" \
SUBMITTED_AT_UTC="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" python3 - "$tmp" "$dest" <<'PY'
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

req = {
    "id": os.environ["ID"],
    "repo": os.environ["REPO"],
    "mode": os.environ["MODE"],
    "engine": os.environ.get("ENGINE") or None,
    "model": os.environ.get("MODEL") or None,
    "thinking": os.environ.get("THINKING") or None,
    "reviewers": os.environ.get("REVIEWERS") or None,
    "base": os.environ.get("BASE") or None,
    "source": os.environ.get("SOURCE") or "cli",
    "operator_id": os.environ.get("OPERATOR_ID") or None,
    "pr_url": os.environ.get("PR_URL") or None,
    "commit_sha": os.environ.get("COMMIT_SHA") or None,
    "submitted_head": os.environ.get("SUBMITTED_HEAD") or None,
    "submitted_at_utc": os.environ.get("SUBMITTED_AT_UTC") or None,
    "ts": int(os.environ["TS"]),
}
req = {key: value for key, value in req.items() if value is not None}
tmp = Path(sys.argv[1])
dest = Path(sys.argv[2])
stable = (
    "id", "repo", "mode", "engine", "model", "thinking", "reviewers", "base",
    "source", "operator_id", "pr_url", "commit_sha", "submitted_head",
)
try:
    with tmp.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(req, handle)
        handle.flush()
        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
    try:
        os.link(tmp, dest)
        disposition = "queued"
    except FileExistsError:
        try:
            existing = json.loads(dest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            raise SystemExit(f"spark-openclaw-queue: existing deterministic request is invalid: {exc.__class__.__name__}")
        if any(existing.get(key) != req.get(key) for key in stable):
            raise SystemExit("spark-openclaw-queue: deterministic request id is already bound to different review identity")
        disposition = "deduped"
finally:
    try:
        tmp.unlink()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
print(f"autoreview-request: {disposition} {dest}", file=sys.stderr)
print(req["id"])
PY
'
  queue_out="$(ssh -- "$TARGET" "bash -s -- $(printf '%q' "$RESOLVED_REQUESTER") $(printf '%q' "$REMOTE_WORKTREE") $(printf '%q' "$MODE") $(printf '%q' "$ENGINE") $(printf '%q' "$REVIEWERS") $(printf '%q' "$MODEL") $(printf '%q' "$THINKING") $(printf '%q' "$BASE") $(printf '%q' "$QUEUE_STATE") $(printf '%q' "$PR_URL") $(printf '%q' "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL") $(printf '%q' "$OPERATOR_ID") $(printf '%q' "$QUEUE_REQUEST_ID")" <<<"$queue_script" 2>&1)"
  queue_rc=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$queue_out" >&2
  if [ "$queue_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
    lane_emit failed "" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview queue submit failed rc=$queue_rc" "see stderr"
    exit 3
  fi
  if [ -n "$QUEUE_REQUEST_ID" ]; then
    queue_id="$QUEUE_REQUEST_ID"
  else
    queue_id="$(printf '%s\n' "$queue_out" | awk '/^req-/{id=$0} END{print id}' | tr -d '\r')"
  fi
  queue_request="$(printf '%s\n' "$queue_out" | sed -n -E 's/^autoreview-request: (queued|deduped) //p' | tail -n 1 | tr -d '\r')"
  [ -n "$queue_id" ] || queue_id="$queue_request"
  dashboard_publish_needed="$(mark_swarmdash_publish_needed \
    "review_queue.queued" \
    "queue_id=$queue_id operator_id=$OPERATOR_ID commit_sha=$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL pr_url=${PR_URL:-missing}")"
  queue_proof="$local_dir/QUEUE_PROOF.md"
  cat > "$queue_proof" <<PROOF
# Spark OpenClaw Queue Submit Proof

- lane: spark-openclaw-autoreview
- host: $TARGET
- run_id: $run_id
- queue_id: $queue_id
- operator_id: $OPERATOR_ID
- queue_request: $queue_request
- queue_state: $QUEUE_STATE
- worktree: $REMOTE_WORKTREE
- commit_sha: $RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL
- pr_url: $PR_URL
- dashboard_publish_needed: $dashboard_publish_needed
- mode: $MODE
- engine: $ENGINE
- reviewers: $REVIEWERS
- base: $BASE
- result: queued
- secrets_inspected: no
- edits: no
- deploys: no
- sends: no

This queued a Spark-owned OpenClaw review request and returned immediately.
The Spark watcher owns claim, execution, heartbeat, result, and terminal proof.
PROOF
  proof_rel="runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id/QUEUE_PROOF.md"
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="packet_ready"
  lane_emit queued "$proof_rel" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview queued request $queue_id on $TARGET" ""
  exit 0
fi

remote_script='
set -u
run_id="$1"
runner="$2"
skills="$3"
worktree="$4"
mode="$5"
engine="$6"
reviewers="$7"
model="$8"
thinking="$9"
base="${10:-}"
pr_url="${11:-}"
operator_id="${12:-}"

run_dir="$HOME/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id"
mkdir -p "$run_dir"
printf "%s\n" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$run_dir/heartbeat"
printf "{\"ts\":\"%s\",\"event\":\"started\",\"run_id\":\"%s\",\"mode\":\"%s\",\"engine\":\"%s\",\"reviewers\":\"%s\",\"operator_id\":\"%s\"}\n" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$run_id" "$mode" "$engine" "$reviewers" "$operator_id" > "$run_dir/events.jsonl"

head="$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
head_full="$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
root="$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$worktree")"

HEAD_FULL="$head_full" HEAD_SHORT="$head" PR_URL="$pr_url" WORKTREE="$root" BASE_REF="$base" OPERATOR_ID="$operator_id" python3 - <<'PY' > "$run_dir/review-metadata.json" 2>/dev/null || true
import json
import os

print(json.dumps({
    "commit_sha": os.environ.get("HEAD_FULL") or None,
    "commit_short": os.environ.get("HEAD_SHORT") or None,
    "pr_url": os.environ.get("PR_URL") or None,
    "worktree": os.environ.get("WORKTREE") or None,
    "base": os.environ.get("BASE_REF") or None,
    "operator_id": os.environ.get("OPERATOR_ID") or None,
}, indent=2))
PY

cat > "$run_dir/STATE.md" <<STATE
# Spark OpenClaw Autoreview State

status: running
run_id: $run_id
worktree: $root
head: $head
commit_sha: $head_full
pr_url: $pr_url
operator_id: $operator_id
runner: $runner
agent_skills_dir: $skills
mode: $mode
engine: $engine
reviewers: $reviewers
base: $base
STATE

args=(--mode "$mode")
if [ -n "$reviewers" ]; then
  args+=(--reviewers "$reviewers")
elif [ -n "$engine" ]; then
  args+=(--engine "$engine")
fi
[ -n "$model" ] && args+=(--model "$model")
[ -n "$thinking" ] && args+=(--thinking "$thinking")
[ -n "$base" ] && args+=(--base "$base")

requested="$engine"
[ -n "$reviewers" ] && requested="$(printf "%s" "$reviewers" | tr "," " ")"
needs_cli_bootstrap=0
for tool in $requested; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || needs_cli_bootstrap=1
done
if [ "$needs_cli_bootstrap" = "1" ] && [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then
  export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
  . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  nvm use --silent default >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use --silent node >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

AGENT_SKILLS_DIR="$skills" "$runner" "$worktree" "${args[@]}" > "$run_dir/autoreview.stdout" 2> "$run_dir/autoreview.stderr"
rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  result=completed
elif [ "$rc" -eq 1 ]; then
  result=needs-human
else
  result=failed
fi

cat > "$run_dir/PROOF.md" <<PROOF
# Spark OpenClaw Autoreview Proof

- lane: spark-openclaw-autoreview
- host: spark-2
- run_id: $run_id
- runner: $runner
- agent_skills_dir: $skills
- worktree: $root
- head: $head
- commit_sha: $head_full
- pr_url: $pr_url
- operator_id: $operator_id
- mode: $mode
- engine: $engine
- reviewers: $reviewers
- model: $model
- thinking: $thinking
- base: $base
- result: $result
- exit_code: $rc
- stdout: autoreview.stdout
- stderr: autoreview.stderr
- metadata: review-metadata.json
- secrets_inspected: no
- destructive_cleanup: no
- edits: no
- deploys: no
- sends: no
PROOF

cat > "$run_dir/STATE.md" <<STATE
# Spark OpenClaw Autoreview State

status: $result
run_id: $run_id
worktree: $root
head: $head
commit_sha: $head_full
pr_url: $pr_url
operator_id: $operator_id
runner: $runner
agent_skills_dir: $skills
mode: $mode
engine: $engine
reviewers: $reviewers
base: $base
exit_code: $rc
STATE

printf "{\"ts\":\"%s\",\"event\":\"finished\",\"run_id\":\"%s\",\"result\":\"%s\",\"exit_code\":%s,\"operator_id\":\"%s\"}\n" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$run_id" "$result" "$rc" "$operator_id" >> "$run_dir/events.jsonl"
exit "$rc"
'

ssh -- "$TARGET" "bash -s -- $(printf '%q' "$run_id") $(printf '%q' "$RESOLVED_RUNNER") $(printf '%q' "$RESOLVED_SKILLS") $(printf '%q' "$REMOTE_WORKTREE") $(printf '%q' "$MODE") $(printf '%q' "$ENGINE") $(printf '%q' "$REVIEWERS") $(printf '%q' "$MODEL") $(printf '%q' "$THINKING") $(printf '%q' "$BASE") $(printf '%q' "$PR_URL") $(printf '%q' "$OPERATOR_ID")" <<<"$remote_script"
rc=$?

rsync -az -- "$TARGET:~/Developer/_machine-runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id/" "$local_dir/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
proof_rel="runs/spark-openclaw-autoreview-runs/$run_id/PROOF.md"
LANE_TERMINAL_PROOF="$proof_rel"

if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ -f "$proof_rel" ]; then
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
  lane_emit completed "$proof_rel" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview completed on $TARGET" ""
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$rc" -eq 1 ] && [ -f "$proof_rel" ]; then
  LANE_PROOF_STATUS="closed"
  lane_emit needs-human "$proof_rel" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview found actionable review findings on $TARGET" "classify findings before routing fixes"
  exit 3
fi

LANE_PROOF_STATUS="failed"
lane_emit failed "$proof_rel" "$RESOLVED_HEAD_FULL" "$PR_URL" "spark-openclaw-autoreview failed rc=$rc on $TARGET" "see $proof_rel or remote machine run"
exit 3
